items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: He was my roommate and my car-mate when we go on the road. And he taught me a lot too.

ctx.x: What was his name, Jumpin' George...?

I think his name was Jumpin' George Jones, I think his last name is. Anyway, we had an act and that opened up a new world to me, of the stage and stage business. And that gave me a new dimension, you know what I mean, 'cause the stage is very serious...a lot of people think...and of course Timmy was a comedian, but he sang and people thought that... you know people on stage...but it's very serious and dedicated worker...it opened up a new world for me. But Timmy Rogers encouraged me and so did Buck and Bubbles.…
noons. So we end up some weeks doin' nine days. I'd never been through nothin' like that before. But that was show business. (laughter)
